data.one_liner: An xterm-256 color support library for changing terminal text colors and backgrounds.
data.what_it_does: Provides AnsiPen to add ANSI color codes to terminal log messages and text output. Supports setting foreground and background colors easily and globally disabling colors for production.
use_when: You want to colorize terminal logs or command-line outputs in Dart
You need xterm-256 color support for CLI tools
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter GUI application rather than a CLI tool
You need a full-featured logging framework with severity levels and formatting
strengths: Supports xterm-256 colors and RGB coloring
Easy global disabling for production environments
weaknesses: Relies on stdio to detect ANSI support which can sometimes be wrong
Limited to adding ANSI color codes
data.setup_notes: No dependencies or complex setup required.

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a complete logging solution with pretty printing and log levels rather than just raw ANSI color pens.

alternatives.name: mason_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are building complex CLI tools and need advanced logging, progress indicators, and standard CLI styling.

data.minimal_example:
AnsiPen pen = AnsiPen()..white(bold: true);
print(pen("Bright white foreground") + " this text is default fg/bg");
